newsitem.title: USA: Paramount says Calif. hydrotreater down 6-8 weeks.
newsitem.headline: Paramount says Calif. hydrotreater down 6-8 weeks.

text.p: A hydrotreater at Paramount Petroleum Corp's Los Angeles refinery will remain shut six to eight weeks to undergo repairs following an explosion Friday on one of its heaters, a company spokesman said.
The unit makes 6,000 to 8,000 barrels-per-day of CARB diesel fuel.
"It's going to take about six to eight weeks to bring it back up," a refinery spokesman said.
The cause of the explosion, which occurred late Friday, remains under investigation.
"We've narrowed it down to a few things," he said
The refinery can process about 46,000 barrels-per-day of crude oil.
Production of gasoline and asphalt remains normal at the plant, the spokesman said.
Following the news of the explosion, CARB diesel prices rose about two cents early to 88/90 cents a gallon.
